headline: Uzbekistan and Oman aim to raise trade turnover to $1 billion
summary: Uzbekistan and Oman intend to raise mutual trade to $1 billion, President Shavkat Mirziyoyev said at a business forum in Muscat. A $5 billion portfolio of projects was formed during the visit.
why: Bilateral trade targets and project portfolios signal the pace of investment and export flows between Central Asia and Gulf states, which matter for regional infrastructure and resource sectors.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston va O‘mon tovar ayirboshlash hajmini $1 mlrdga yetkazmoqchi
